articles.title: Snakeskin
articles.summary: Fine diamond scale lattice in charcoal and brown, broken by dark blotch banding, glossy with soft sparkle. Reads as a dark, peacock-toned snakeskin or reptile hide in teal, bronze and plum-black; the oval blotch rhythm is the main read.
articles.what: A fine diamond scale lattice broken by dark blotch banding — a serpent-cryptid snakeskin FRACTURED CRYPTID finish. Up close: Overlapping tiny round scales (3-5 px) arranged in rows that swirl around large elongated oval blotches, 60-100 px long, with teal-green centres, olive-bronze rims and dark plum-black bands between. Scales have bright specks; colour moves from teal to bronze to purple across each blotch. From a distance: Reads as a dark, peacock-toned snakeskin or reptile hide in teal, bronze and plum-black; the oval blotch rhythm is the main read. Measured spec (average): metal 55, roughness 47, coat 107. Shine: gloss. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.
